excerpts.author: jgm
excerpts.content: As per the comment: the epoch in the voluntary exit is the earliest epoch at which the message will be considered valid.  That is separate from the earliest epoch at which the validator can be exited.  Both conditions need to be met for the message to be included on-chain.
